name: Dumbbell Incline Single-Arm Lateral Raise
steps: Sit on the seat of the incline bench with your feet apart and a dumbbell in one hand.
Lean toward your empty hand and brace it on that thigh, letting the dumbbell hang beneath your working shoulder.
Lift the dumbbell out to the side until your upper arm is roughly horizontal.
Guide the dumbbell down, then change hands and lean to the other side.
tips: Keep your torso at the same angle as the dumbbell rises and falls.
Lead with the elbow and keep it slightly bent throughout the arc.
